name: invariant_number
description: The invariant's identifier within its specification — a string such as "I-83" (canonical), a bare sequence number ("17", legacy), or a rule-set-qualified form ("011-1").

aiGuidance.purpose: The invariant's identifier within its specification.
aiGuidance.extraction: Canonical form is "I-<n>" (e.g. "I-83"). Legacy records carry bare digit strings ("17") and rule-set-qualified forms ("011-1"); preserve the stored form verbatim — do not normalise.
